failed_apis.why_tried: agent copied the UWP source 1:1 first (the shared-content files used MediaElement + SetSource + GetAsCastingSource)
failed_apis.root_cause: MediaElement does not exist in WinUI 3; MediaPlayerElement is a thin view over an underlying MediaPlayer, so imperative playback/source/casting calls are NOT on the element
failed_apis.fix: XAML <MediaElement> -> <MediaPlayerElement>; code-behind video.SetSource(stream,type) -> video.Source = MediaSource.CreateFromStream(stream,type); video.GetAsCastingSource() -> video.MediaPlayer.GetAsCastingSource()

doc_errors.wrong: 'Source and transport-control properties carry over with minor renames.'
doc_errors.correct: It is not a 1:1 rename. MediaPlayerElement exposes no SetSource and no playback/casting methods; those move to the underlying MediaPlayer (video.MediaPlayer.Play()/GetAsCastingSource()), and Source takes an IMediaPlaybackSource (MediaSource.CreateFromStream/CreateFromUri) rather than a stream/Uri via SetSource.

special_apis.special_handling: view-only control over a MediaPlayer; set element.Source = MediaSource.Create...; reach element.MediaPlayer for Play/Pause/GetAsCastingSource/PlaybackSession.

anchored to a coordinate Rect computed via TransformToVisual(App.MainWindow.Content); covered generically by the existing 'apply InitializeWithWindow to other UI surfaces that target a window' guidance.
